page.overview:
Who is Uz Bonearm?

Uz Bonearm was a male smuggler at Byss Bistro. He helped Shug Ninx, Salla Zend, and the New Republic when the reborn Emperor attempted to take over the galaxy. He was the captain of the Bespin Bandit.
